faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our shipping services.
faq.q1: How can I track my package?
faq.a1: Once your package is received at our warehouse, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. Use this number on our tracking page to follow your package in real time.
faq.a2: Our shipping rates depend on the actual weight (lbs) or the dimensional size (L×W×H) of your package, whichever is greater. Use our calculator for an instant estimate.
faq.a3: Air cargo typically takes 3-5 business days. Sea freight takes 2-4 weeks depending on the destination. Delivery times may vary based on customs processing.
faq.q4: What forms of payment are accepted?
faq.a4: We accept cash, bank transfer, Zelle, Visa, and MasterCard. Payment can be made online or at any of our branch offices.
faq.a5: Your package is automatically insured for up to $100 in case of loss. Additional insurance can be purchased based on the declared value of your items.
faq.q6: Where does J and C Transport ship?
faq.a6: We ship between the United States, Haiti, and the Dominican Republic. We have branch offices in all three countries for your convenience.
faq.q7: How do I create an account?
faq.a7: You can create a free personal or business account on our website. Just click 'Get Started' and fill in your information to receive your personalized shipping address.
faq.q8: What items are prohibited from shipping?
faq.a8: Prohibited items include hazardous materials, flammable substances, weapons, illegal drugs, and perishable goods without proper packaging. Contact us for a complete list.
faq.q9: What is RUA and do I need it?
faq.a9: For shipments to the Dominican Republic, customs requires a Registro Único Aduanero (RUA). We help you set this up.
faq.a10: You earn points for every package you ship. These points can be redeemed for discounts or free shipments.
